notes.title: A lot of languages!
notes.content:
Since release we've added support of numerous different languages. This became possible mostly by SteamGifts community. Big thanks to them! However there are still many languages left and you can help with it. Visit [url=https://www.steamgifts.com/discussion/ewrf8/community-help-localization]this link[/url]. Currently there are following languages:
[list]
[*]Arabic
[*]Belarusian
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Czech
[*]English
[*]Estonian
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Greek
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Polish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Spanish
[*]Thai
[*]Traditional Chinese
[*]Turkish
[*]Ukrainian
[/list]

Also, if you still don't have the game, you can try to win it [url=https://www.steamgifts.com/giveaway/ymkJ4/breaking-good]here[/url].

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with completed compounds counter which would make you think that game is shorter than it is. Bug affected only purple compounds related achievements and appropriate Steam stats (you got achievements earlier than you should).
[*]2 times more music.
[*]Added various languages.
[/list]
